lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns beginning posterior to the fifth gill slit. The spatial distribution follows a semi-regular grid with higher density in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Linear vertical regions of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a network of high-intensity nodes against the darker background.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to dark (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small teleost fish swimming beneath the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
